pages.text: Asmodeus, Beelzebub, Belphegor, Leviathan, Lucifer, Mammon, and Satan — Beatrice's seven furniture servants.$(br2)While $(bold)Beatrice remains alive$(reset) in the Golden Land, defeated Stakes revive after a brief delay. Defeat Beatrice herself to end the battle.
The shared weapon wielded by the Seven Stakes.
